targets.expr: sum(sum by (team_id) (rate(forcad_team_http_requests_total{job=~"forcad_api|forcad_receiver"}[1m]) and on (job, instance) (up{job=~"forcad_api|forcad_receiver"} == 1)) * on (team_id) group_left (team_name) max by (team_id, team_name) (forcad:team_info:latest{team_id=~"${team}"}))

panels.title: ForcAD RPS - ${team:text}
panels.description: Board/API/receiver requests for selected teams. All shows their combined total. Excludes game services.

targets.expr: sum(sum by (team_id) (forcad_team_websocket_connections{job="forcad_api"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="forcad_api"} == 1)) * on (team_id) group_left (team_name) max by (team_id, team_name) (forcad:team_info:latest{team_id=~"${team}"}))

panels.title: ForcAD WebSocket connections by team - ${team:text}
panels.description: Open board WebSockets for selected teams. All shows their combined total.

targets.expr: sum(sum by (team_id) (rate(forcad_team_websocket_upgrades_total{job="forcad_api"}[1m]) and on (job, instance) (up{job="forcad_api"} == 1)) * on (team_id) group_left (team_name) max by (team_id, team_name) (forcad:team_info:latest{team_id=~"${team}"}))

panels.title: ForcAD New WebSocket connections/s - ${team:text}
panels.description: New board WebSocket upgrades for selected teams. All shows their combined rate.

targets.expr: sum(forcad_websocket_connections{job="forcad_api"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="forcad_api"} == 1))
sum(forcad_websocket_connection_limit{job="forcad_api"} and on (job, instance) (up{job="forcad_api"} == 1))

panels.title: ForcAD WebSocket capacity - all API replicas
panels.description: Open board WS and capacity across all healthy API replicas; independent of the Team filter.

targets.expr: sum((8 / 1000000 * sum by (team_ip) (rate(forcad_team_network_transmit_bytes_total[1m]) and on (job, instance) (up{job="forcad_router"} == 1))) * on (team_ip) group_left (team_id) forcad:team_network_info:unique * on (team_id) group_left (team_name) max by (team_id, team_name) (forcad:team_info:latest{team_id=~"${team}"}))

sum((8 / 1000000 * sum by (team_ip) (rate(forcad_team_network_receive_bytes_total[1m]) and on (job, instance) (up{job="forcad_router"} == 1))) * on (team_ip) group_left (team_id) forcad:team_network_info:unique * on (team_id) group_left (team_name) max by (team_id, team_name) (forcad:team_info:latest{team_id=~"${team}"}))

panels.title: Network traffic - ${team:text}
panels.description: Forwarded bytes for selected team networks, by direction. Ambiguous team IPs are excluded.

targets.expr: sum(sum by (team_ip) (rate(forcad_team_network_transmit_packets_total[1m]) and on (job, instance) (up{job="forcad_router"} == 1)) * on (team_ip) group_left (team_id) forcad:team_network_info:unique * on (team_id) group_left (team_name) max by (team_id, team_name) (forcad:team_info:latest{team_id=~"${team}"}))

sum(sum by (team_ip) (rate(forcad_team_network_receive_packets_total[1m]) and on (job, instance) (up{job="forcad_router"} == 1)) * on (team_ip) group_left (team_id) forcad:team_network_info:unique * on (team_id) group_left (team_name) max by (team_id, team_name) (forcad:team_info:latest{team_id=~"${team}"}))

panels.title: Packets/s - ${team:text}
panels.description: Forwarded packets for selected team networks, by direction.

targets.expr: topk(${rows:raw}, ( sum by (source_ip, team_ip) (rate(forcad_network_source_packets_total{job="forcad_router"}[5m]) and on (job, instance) (forcad_network_source_scrape_success{job="forcad_router"} == 1)) * on (team_ip) group_left (team_name) max by (team_ip, team_name) (forcad:team_info:latest{team_id!="__unknown__",team_id=~"${team}"})) > 0)

panels.title: Top ${rows} sources to selected vulnboxes
panels.description: Selectable top ${rows:raw} original source/vulnbox pairs over five minutes, after router filtering and before SNAT. Scroll inside the table to inspect all selected rows. Requires the router exporter.

targets.expr: min(forcad:game_sensor_ready or on (job, instance) (0 * up{job="forcad_game_sensor"}))

panels.title: Capture status
panels.description: Configured sensors only. No targets means the sensor is not installed.

targets.expr: max(time() - forcad_game_sync_timestamp_seconds)

panels.title: Heartbeat age
panels.description: A heartbeat older than 45 seconds excludes the sensor from game panels.

targets.expr: sum(rate(forcad_game_capture_dropped_packets_total[1m]))

panels.title: Capture drops/s
panels.description: System capture drops; nonzero values can mean incomplete counts.

targets.expr: sum(rate(forcad_game_stream_gaps_total[1m]))

panels.title: Stream gaps/s
panels.description: Missing TCP stream data, including capture loss or unseen directions.

panels.title: Active directions - last minute
panels.description: Click a team name to select the pair; sort columns by load. Inactive pairs are hidden; missing metrics show N/A. Same-team rows mean own-box access. High load alone does not prove a violation.

targets.expr: sum(sum by (source_team_ip, team_ip) (rate(forcad_game_http_requests_total{source_team_ip=~"${source}",team_ip=~"${target}"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) forcad:game_sensor_ready))

panels.title: Game HTTP requests/s
panels.description: Observed plaintext HTTP/1 requests for the selection, including upgrades. All -> All is the game total.

targets.expr: sum(sum by (source_team_ip, team_ip) (forcad_game_websocket_connections{source_team_ip=~"${source}",team_ip=~"${target}"} and on (job, instance) forcad:game_sensor_ready))

panels.title: Open game WebSockets
panels.description: Observed WS upgrades until TCP close/reset or five idle minutes, summed for the selection.

targets.expr: sum(sum by (source_team_ip, team_ip) ((rate(forcad_network_source_packets_total{job="forcad_router",team_ip=~"${target}"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) (forcad_network_source_scrape_success == 1 and on (job, instance) up == 1)) * on (source_ip) group_left (source_team_ip) forcad:game_peer_info{source_team_ip=~"${source}"}))

panels.title: VPN -> vulnbox packets/s
panels.description: Selected VPN peer -> vulnbox packets after router filtering, before SNAT; includes non-game ports.

targets.expr: sum(sum by (source_team_ip, team_ip) (forcad_game_tcp_connections{source_team_ip=~"${source}",team_ip=~"${target}"} and on (job, instance) forcad:game_sensor_ready))

panels.title: Established TCP connections
panels.description: Observed established TCP connections until close/reset or five idle minutes, summed for the selection.

targets.expr: sum(8 * (sum by (source_team_ip, team_ip) ((rate(forcad_network_source_bytes_total{job="forcad_router",team_ip=~"${target}"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) (forcad_network_source_scrape_success == 1 and on (job, instance) up == 1)) * on (source_ip) group_left (source_team_ip) forcad:game_peer_info{source_team_ip=~"${source}"})))

panels.title: VPN -> vulnbox bandwidth
panels.description: Selected VPN peer -> vulnbox bandwidth after router filtering, before SNAT; includes non-game ports.

targets.expr: sum(sum by (source_team_ip, team_ip) (rate(forcad_game_tcp_flows_total{source_team_ip=~"${source}",team_ip=~"${target}"}[$__rate_interval]) and on (job, instance) forcad:game_sensor_ready))

panels.title: New TCP flows/s
